description: This file defines a class 'Ssr' within the Opencart system, responsible for creating static HTML pages from dynamic responses during specific trigger events. It extends the core Controller class and includes an 'index' method that captures the current output and prepares it for saving as a static file.

classes.name: Ssr
classes.description: A controller class responsible for generating static HTML pages from dynamic content on specific trigger points.
